subject: [PATCH v5 07/12] mm/mmzone: read each zoneref slot once when filtering by nodemask

2026-11-01.patch_summary: This patch fixes a bug where the kernel would dereference a NULL pointer when filtering by nodemask, caused by reading each zoneref slot twice in the __next_zones_zonelist function. The fix is to read each slot only once and test its zone directly. This change also removes unnecessary code paths for non-NUMA configurations.
